P.name: Pyromania
P.title: Template:Data Annie/Pyromania
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Pyromania|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Annie
|skill        = I
|icon         = Pyromania.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate - Pyromania:}} '''Annie''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Pyromania'' whenever she hits an enemy with ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'' or casts her other {{tip|abilities}}, stacking up to 4 times, at which she gains ''Energized''.
|description2 = {{sbc|Energized:}} '''Annie''' empowers her next cast of ''{{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}}'', ''{{ai|Incinerate|Annie}}'', or ''{{ai|Summon: Tibbers|Annie}}'' to consume all ''Pyromania'' stacks to {{tip|stun}} enemies hit for {{pp|1.25;1.5;1.75|1;6;11}} seconds.
|description3 = '''Annie''' gains maximum stacks of ''Pyromania'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]]. She will lose ''Energized'' and all ''Pyromania'' stacks upon [[death]].
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|spellshield  = True
|notes        = 
* '''Annie''' does not lose any stacks upon entering or exiting {{tip|resurrection}}.
* Stacks are gained even if the ability is blocked by {{tip|spell shield}}.
* ''Pyromania's'' current stacks are represented by a counter under '''Annie's''' [[health bar]], visible to all players. It lights up when the empowered effect is available.
|tips         =
* The stun applies to the first ability that lands when the stun is available. If you cast {{ai|Disintegrate|Annie}} followed by {{ai|Incinerate|Annie}} while the stun is available and ''Incinerate'' lands first, the stun will be applied through ''Incinerate''.
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Annie}} spell-casts generate stacks. At maximum stacks, her next offensive spell will consume them to {{tip|stun}} the target.
}}

Q.title: Template:Data Annie/Disintegrate
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Disintegrate|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Annie
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Disintegrate.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 260}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
|description2 = If this kills the target, ''Disintegrate's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 50% and its {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 625
|cooldown     = 4
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 80}}
|costtype     = Mana
|speed        = 1400
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|projectile   = True
|callforhelp  = True
|spelleffects = spell
|spellshield  = True
|notes  = 
* ''Disintegrate'' will also grant the cooldown reduction and mana cost refund if the target is dead upon the missile's arrival.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Annie}} hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}}.
|blurb2       = If this kills the target, the {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced and the {{as|{{sti|mana cost}}}} is refunded.
}}

E.name: Molten Shield
E.title: Template:Data Annie/Molten Shield
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Molten Shield|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Annie
|skill        = E
|icon         = Molten Shield.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' grants herself or the target allied {{tip|champion}} and {{ui|Tibbers}} a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds and {{as|{{pplevel|20 to 50|key=%}}|movement speed}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|leveling     = {{st|Shield Strength|{{ap|60 to 200}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
|description2 = While ''Molten Shield'' is active, enemies that deal damage to it take {{as|magic damage}}. This may only occur once per enemy per cast for each active ''Molten Shield''.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 65}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = 10
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} 800
|cost         = {{ap|60 to 80}}
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = none
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = [[Unit-targeted|Unit]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]
|spelleffects = aoe
|damagetype   = Magic
|affects      = Self, Enemies
|outofrange   = If targeting an ally, walk in range of the target unit to cast
|notes        = 
* ''Molten Shield'' casts on ally if targeted or if very close to targeting them (within a range of 225); otherwise self casts.
* ''Molten Shield'' does not deal damage to {{tip|turret|turrets}} when attacked by them.
* ''Molten Shield'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
* Attacks that are {{tip|dodged}} or {{tip|blind|miss}} against the shielded target will not cause the shield to deal damage, while {{tip|block|blocked}} attacks still deal damage to the attacker.
* The reaction damage does not trigger from {{cai|Noxious Trap|Teemo}} and {{cai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}.{{bug}}
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Annie}} grants herself or an allied champion—and {{ui|Tibbers}}—a {{tip|shield}} with a burst of {{sti|ms|{{as|move speed}}}}.
|blurb2       = While the shield holds, enemies who {{tip|basic attack}} it take {{as|magic damage}}.
}}

R.name: Summon: Tibbers
R.title: Template:Data Annie/Summon: Tibbers
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Summon: Tibbers|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Annie
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|icon2        = Summon Tibbers.png
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Annie''' gains {{sti|{{as|magic penetration}}}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Penetration|{{ap|10 to 20 3}}%}}
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location in a burst of flame, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies near him. ''Summon: Tibbers'' can be recast at any time while {{ui|Tibbers}} is alive.
|leveling2    = {{st|Initial Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 400}} {{as|(+ 75% AP)}}}}
|description3 = {{ui|Tibbers}} then remains on the field as a controllable {{tip|pet}} for up to 45 seconds.
|icon4        = Summon- Tibbers 2.png
|description4 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Annie''' directs {{ui|Tibbers}} to the target location.
|description5 = ''Summon: Tibbers' recast can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}. See [[Annie#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{ui|Tibbers}}.''
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|600|Cast range}} <!-- / {{tt|X|Tibbers snap-back range}}-->
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|250|Summon impact radius}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|350|Tibbers' aura radius}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|130 to 100}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time    = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Initial cast}}|{{tt|None|Recasts}}}}
|queue time   = {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Initial cast}}
|targeting    = Location
|damagetype   = magic
|spelleffects = special
|affects      = Enemies / Tibbers
|spellshield  = True
|outofrange   = Walk in range of the target location to cast (first cast)
|notes        = 
* Only the initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}<!-- and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive-->.
** Recasting the ability does, however, count as casting an ultimate ability for the purposes of {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}} and similar effects.{{bug}}
** {{pending for test}} What about {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}}?
* The active deals {{tip|area damage}}.
* Tibbers will {{tip|blink}} back next to '''Annie''' if he gets too far away.
* Recasting ''Summon: Tibbers'' does not interrupt {{sis|Recall}} channel.
|flavorsound = {{sm2|Annie_Original_R_1.ogg}} ''"Get 'em, Tibbers!"''
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb         = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Annie}} gains {{as|{{sti|magic penetration}}}}.
|blurb2        = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Annie''' summons her bear {{ui|Tibbers}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies in the area.
|blurb3       = {{ui|Tibbers}} deals {{as|magic damage}} with his attacks and also burns nearby enemies. Re-cast to direct him.
}}
